t: The Timeguard STFM360 is a robust, flush-mounted PIR motion sensor designed for precise automatic lighting control in various environments. Ideal for electricians installing systems in offices, hallways, or utility rooms, this motion detector switch offers a sleek, unobtrusive design. It features a manual override function to maintain illumination as needed, alongside adjustable time-on duration and lux levels for tailored operation. Suitable for 1000W resistive and 200W LED loads, its IP44 rating ensures protection against dust and splashing water, making it reliable for indoor use. 360° detection angle with a 6m diameter detection coverage at a 3m mounting height. Suitable for 1000W resistive, 200W LED/Fluorescent or Low energy loads.
